title: Fair Federated Learning via Bounded Group Loss
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The benchmarks measure group fairness in federated machine learning models, specifically focusing on performance disparities across demographic groups defined by race and gender.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on demonstrating a method for achieving group fairness in federated learning for protected attributes such as race and gender, showing that their proposed method (PFFL) can improve fairness without sacrificing, and in some cases improving, model accuracy compared to baselines.
